authority_basis: AI Nutri v2.0 §§23–25 ScientificClaim / ScientificRelation / dependency
AI Nutri v2.0 §§34–36 Evidence Quality, MethodologicalAppraisal, EvidenceCertaintyAssessment
Nutrition Foundation v0.1 II.8 Scientific evidence / Recommendation / Applicability

appraisal_route.required_route: Study-level methodological appraisal + EvidenceBody/Synthesis + claim-level certainty using an appropriate recognized framework when applicable
Review-method appraisal (e.g. framework appropriate to review type) + dependency/overlap handling + claim-level certainty
Guideline/recommendation process appraisal and explicit separation of recommendation strength from underlying evidence certainty
Evidence contribution + directness/scope + deterministic reconstruction where applicable; empirical effect certainty may legitimately be NOT_APPLICABLE

current_result: No current claim is an empirical treatment-effect claim; do not assign GRADE-like HIGH/MODERATE/LOW merely to create a certainty label.
future_rule: When a future claim asserts an empirical effect magnitude/direction, NOT_APPLICABLE is no longer acceptable solely because the source is a guideline; the underlying evidence body must be reconstructed to the level required by the claim.
